instructions: Cursor/Composer: read fixQueue. Fix items with status "approved" first, then "pending" if asked. Set status to "fixed" in the admin toolbox after shipping. Do not auto-fix "rejected" or "deferred" items.

fixQueue.title: Elements with visible text labels do not have matching accessible names.
fixQueue.description: Fixed homepage mismatches: MegaSearchBar submit (removed aria-label conflicting with visible "Buscar"), HomeNavbar logo link (removed redundant aria-label), ModeToggle (removed duplicate sr-only English label).
fixQueue.reviewNotes: Shipped in commit — mark DB items fixed after deploy.

fixQueue.title: LCP request discovery
fixQueue.description: Added marketing layout preload for hero LCP image, fetchPriority=high on first hero Image, tuned sizes/quality.
fixQueue.reviewNotes: Re-scan after deploy to confirm LCP audit improvement.

fixQueue.title: Improve image delivery
fixQueue.description: Hero grid uses lower quality for non-LCP tiles, lazy loading below-fold gig cards, long-cache headers for /icons and static images.
fixQueue.reviewNotes: Further gains possible by compressing source JPGs in public/icons.

fixQueue.title: Reduce unused JavaScript / Legacy JavaScript / Render-blocking
fixQueue.description: Code-split CategoriesSection + StatsAndPopular via dynamic import; Inter font display:swap; browserslist targets modern ES modules.
fixQueue.reviewNotes: Legacy JS savings depend on Next/SWC respecting browserslist — verify on next scan.

fixQueue.title: Use efficient cache lifetimes
fixQueue.description: Added Cache-Control immutable 1y headers for /icons/* and static image extensions in next.config.ts.

fixQueue.title: Scan warning
fixQueue.description: UserLens: prefer in-process Lighthouse before PSI (avoids quota spam); expanded outputFileTracingIncludes for lighthouse/**; filter informational warnings from fix queue.
fixQueue.reviewNotes: Set PAGESPEED_INSIGHTS_API_KEY in Vercel for dedicated PSI quota as optional fallback.
